items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: John O'Dowd is taking the band over at the place over at the-

ctx.x: I cannot recall his first name just now, maybe before this interview was over. We can come back to it. But I know him very, Charlie Jackson. Charlie Jackson, he was killed some years later. And I joined Joe Oliver and went to play one in Gaydon with him in South Bend, Indiana, and nothing happened there. I don't remember whether it was the weather or anyhow it was called off when they got to South Bend. So I never did play in Joe Oliver's band. In the meantime the band splits up and John O'Dowd is taking the band…
